userStories.title: Create Pucho workflow JSON generator utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a utility that generates valid Pucho AI Studio workflow JSON (schemaVersion 7) so the dashboard can create backend API endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/workflow.ts exports TypeScript types: PuchoWorkflow, PuchoTrigger, PuchoAction, PuchoToolName
PuchoToolName is a union type: 'webhook' | 'http' | 'code' | 'schedule' | 'google-sheets' | 'gmail' | 'slack'
createAction(toolName, actionName, input?) returns a valid PuchoAction object with pieceName '@puchoaistudio/tool-{toolName}', pieceVersion '~0.4.8'
chainActions(...actions) links actions via nextAction pointers, last action has nextAction: null
createWorkflow(name, trigger, firstAction) returns full PuchoWorkflow object with schemaVersion '7'
createWebhookTrigger(firstAction) creates a trigger with pieceName '@puchoaistudio/tool-webhook', triggerName 'catch_webhook'
All exported functions are properly typed — no 'any' types
npm run build completes without errors
TypeScript typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Schema: { name, template: { trigger: { type: 'PIECE_TRIGGER', settings: { pieceName, pieceVersion, triggerName }, nextAction }, schemaVersion: '7' } }

userStories.title: Create webhook connection manager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a webhook connection manager that auto-wires frontend dashboard data sources to Pucho workflow webhook triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/webhooks.ts exports TypeScript types: WebhookConnection, ConnectionStatus ('connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error')
useWebhookManager() custom React hook using useState, returns: { connections, addConnection, removeConnection, triggerWebhook }
addConnection(sourceName, workflowName, webhookUrl) adds a new WebhookConnection with status 'connected' and auto-generated id
removeConnection(id) removes a connection by id
triggerWebhook(id, payload) is a mock function that logs to console and returns a Promise<boolean> (simulates sending data to workflow)
Each WebhookConnection has: id, sourceName, workflowName, webhookUrl, status, createdAt (ISO string)
3 sample connections pre-populated: 'KPI Dashboard -> Daily Report Workflow', 'Execution Logs -> Error Alert Workflow', 'Chart Data -> Analytics Pipeline'
npm run build completes without errors
TypeScript typecheck passes
